wording_corrections.old: Our input contract requires nonnegative integer counts with used no greater than capacity. The example assumes these conditions; it does not validate them. This week the function prints its result. Week 9 will show how to return a value for later calculations.
wording_corrections.new: The main remaining-space example assumes nonnegative integer counts with used<=capacity; it does not validate them. Its function prints a result. A short return-value preview below prepares you to read the selected transfer script: return hands a value back to the caller, whose print displays it. Week 9 will develop returned values and local state further.
